cohort: 100 newborns at a hospital in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India
finding: Out of 100 newborns screened, 1 was positive for congenital hypothyroidism, 9 had initially high TSH values that normalized on repeat testing, and the rest were normal.
mod_finding: Of the 100 babies, 60 were born by cesarean section and 40 were vaginally delivered.
followup_time: 2 weeks (for repeat TSH testing); 5 months (for positive CH cases)
